verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official CLI for running server-side tasks from the terminal. It covers project management, resources (rows, files, users), and Function deployment, plus `generate` and `types` commands for type-safe SDKs and schema types. It also supports non-interactive, headless use for CI and automation, which suits agent-driven workflows. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI-agent workflows (all evidence is first-party docs or a docs-existence probe).
